Wonderful Trip Experience with *Siddhi Vinayak Tours and Travels*

Three of us visited Arunachal Pradesh last week.
We were struggling to arrange the trip, but then contacted Sidhi Vinayak Travels, Guwahati, Assam—first by WhatsApp message and then by phone.

Avinash was our main point of contact. Our start date was only 18 days away, but he managed to arrange everything within 3–4 days. He also provided the names and telephone numbers of three additional contacts, which was reassuring.

Initially, there were two of us, but a third friend decided to join in the last few days. They handled this change smoothly, including rearranging hotels to accommodate us.

The advice Avinash gave was accurate and very useful. He organized everything from airport pickup to drop-off.

Our driver was Mintu Das, a pleasant young man. We were very happy with his driving skills, as well as his courteous manner and punctuality. Having him with us made all the difference during eight long days of mountainous travel.

I would happily recommend this team and Mintu Das.
